Common questions from businesses planning a commercial move

Frequently Asked Questions

We’ve answered the most frequent queries from families, renters and homeowners across South Leicestershire to help you understand how we work and what to expect on move day.

CALL US: 0 (116) 456-0653

Can you move outside business hours?

Yes - we can often accommodate evening or weekend slots to minimise disruption to your day.

Can you help if I’m not fully packed?

Absolutely. We can step in with packing support or help finish off the last few boxes.

How much notice do you need?

The earlier the better, but we regularly handle short-notice local moves across South Leicestershire.

Can you dismantle and rebuild furniture?

Yes - we regularly dismantle beds, wardrobes and larger items, then reassemble them in your new home.

Can you collect items from storage or another address?

Yes - we can collect items from storage or another property on the same day as your main move.

Can you remove unwanted items?

We can remove and responsibly dispose of unwanted items as part of your move—just let us know in advance.
